steps.rawOutput:
---

**Subject: Re: Charged twice this month**

Thank you for reporting this, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

I found information about our duplicate charge policy in our system. According to our policy, duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No action is required from you, though I'm happy to help confirm the status if needed.

Since you've identified two identical charges one day apart, this appears to be a billing system error. The extra charge should process as an automatic refund within 5 business days from when it was made.

**To help us investigate this further, could you please reply with:**
- The exact dates of the two charges
- The amount charged each time
- Any other details (like transaction IDs if available)

This will allow me to verify the duplicate charge in our system and confirm that the refund is being processed correctly on your account.

If you don't see the refund within 5 business days, please reach out again and we'll escalate this immediately.

Thanks for your patience!
